name: Kelvan Bresul
appearance: Soft around the middle, red-faced, ceremonial armour polished bright.
sayings: When I was your age, we held the line.
does_not_want: Night patrols near the swamp edge.
dreams: To prove himself in a real fight, which terrifies him.
oddly_also: Half-sees things in the marshes, and drinks so he won't.
family: A wife tired of his drinking; two teenage sons.
